title: Live continuation gains supported only a constrained operating profile
summary: Fresh live workflows supported controlled asynchronous continuation/status drafts with human review on the exact tested implementation. The original assessment did not qualify general interactive serving.
scope: Correctness-normalized native ARC; common patched runtime, return credit, 1,536 GPU and 2,048 CPU blocks. The exact installed-wheel/overlay identity is retained in the source.
limitations: Cold/burst delays, registry lifetime management and conditional trace coverage constrain the result. Later runtime and instrumentation changes are outside this qualification.
decision: Preserve the operating limits alongside the gain; do not transfer qualification automatically to the new implementation.

chart.caption: Original fresh paired estimate and 95% interval for the tested profile; higher is better.
